I wrote `cafe_bill(items, member)` in `solve.py`, but I haven't run it or tested it. There was no `./skills` folder, so I started straight from the brief.

- **Total:** the sum of `price * qty` across all items, in satang.
- **Discounts:** if the total is 50,000 satang (500 baht) or more, it takes 5% off. If `member` is true, it takes another 10% off.
- **VAT:** 7% is added last.
- **Return value:** an integer number of satang.

The brief doesn't say when to round, so I assumed rounding once at the end, half up. The calculation uses integers only, so there are no floating-point errors. If BaanKafe rounds after each step instead, some totals will differ by a satang.
